baseline_evaluation.status: Exploratory baseline: held-out evidence is insufficient against the 0.5 reference.
baseline_evaluation.scope: Pooled divisions and 3/5-round formats; no individualized round-length or division effect is estimated.
baseline_evaluation.uncertainty: Bout bootstrap, conditional on selected C and fixed historical feature design; excludes structural uncertainty. Serial fighter dependence is not captured by iid bout resampling.

snapshot.license: Repository declares GPL-3.0; original-source rights not independently established. Local research copy; no data redistribution in Git.
transformations: Trim surrounding string whitespace; map source URLs to stable entity IDs.
Reject every ambiguous duplicate fight and ambiguous fighter-name identity.
Retain binary non-DQ 3/5-round bouts with complete essential round counts; log all exclusions.
Normalize title/non-title division labels; convert mm:ss to seconds; aggregate competitor-round counts.
Preserve partial metric missingness; strictly earlier-date historical feature generation.
snapshot.missing_value_rules: Missing is not zero. Essential strike/takedown counts are required. Optional partial totals remain missing. 0/0 ratios are missing; forecast differences are imputed to zero inside the pipeline.

warnings: All policy allocations are engineering presets; execution feasibility has not been established by coaching evidence.

recommendation.headline: No robust tactical preference under the tested assumptions.
recommendation.explanation: Striking priority has the highest modeled mean utility. A preference requires supported baseline evidence, a positive paired 95% advantage above the declared margin, and stability throughout the tested grid. Tactical effects remain assumptions; this is not causal evidence of an optimal real-world strategy.

policies.name: Striking priority

policies.assumptions: Planned opportunities, not guaranteed time in fight states.

policies.assumptions: Planned opportunities, not guaranteed time in fight states.

policies.assumptions: Planned opportunities, not guaranteed time in fight states.
